description: Compares TensorGuard static analysis against forward-pass smoke test. TensorGuard operates purely statically (no model instantiation, no GPU, no concrete inputs) while smoke test requires runtime execution.
advantages_of_tensorguard: No runtime execution required (works at CI/review time)
No GPU or specific hardware needed
No concrete input shapes needed (works with symbolic shapes)
Provides formal verification conditions when safe
Catches bugs smoke test misses (e.g., shape-dependent on input size)
